BatchContext.description: A single context entry for a batch list-check request.

BatchContextMembership.description: Membership result for a single context in a batch response.

memberships.description: Map from segment key to membership boolean.

BatchEvaluationResponse.description: Response containing all evaluated flags for the requested context.

results.description: Map of flag keys to results.

BatchEventPayload.description: Payload for a batch event ingestion request (max 500 events).

segment_keys.description: Segment keys to check membership against.

oneOf.description: `>=` — parameter version satisfies the given requirement.

SemverGte.description: `>=` — parameter version satisfies the given requirement.

oneOf.description: True when the segment ID is in the resolved segments set.

InSegment.description: True when the segment ID is in the resolved segments set.

oneOf.description: True when the segment ID is **not** in the resolved segments set.

NotInSegment.description: True when the segment ID is **not** in the resolved segments set.

oneOf.description: True when the specified flag resolved to the specified variant.

FlagEvaluatedAs.description: True when the specified flag resolved to the specified variant.

Condition.description: A single leaf condition that tests one value from an evaluation context.

oneOf.description: At least one child must evaluate to `true`.

Or.description: At least one child must evaluate to `true`.

ConditionExpr.description:
A recursive condition expression supporting arbitrary nesting of AND / OR / NOT.

# Evaluation rules
- `And([])` evaluates to `true`  (vacuously true)
- `Or([])` evaluates to `false` (vacuously false)
- `And` short-circuits on the first `false` child
- `Or` short-circuits on the first `true` child

ContextList.description: Include and exclude lists for a specific context type.

exclude.description: Keys to exclude from the segment (takes precedence over include).

include.description: Keys to include in the segment.

CreateEventDefinitionRequest.description: Request body for registering a new event definition.

key.description: URL-safe string key, unique within the environment.

value_type.description: The metric value type this event will carry.

CreateExperimentRequest.description: Request body for creating a new experiment.

description.description: Optional description of what the experiment tests.

flag_rule_id.description: The flag rule this experiment is bound to.

hypothesis.description: Optional hypothesis statement for the experiment.

metric_keys.description: Pre-registered event definition keys to use as metrics (at least one required).

min_sample_size.description: Optional informational minimum sample size guardrail.

scheduled_end_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 scheduled end time (informational only).

scheduled_start_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 scheduled start time (informational only).

traffic_allocation.description: Percentage of rule-matched contexts to enrol (0.1–100.0); defaults to 100.0.

CreateFlagRequest.description: Request to create a new feature flag.

CreateSegmentRequest.description: Request to create a new segment.

key.description: URL-safe string key (unique within the environment).

lists.description: List definitions for list-based segments (optional, required if type is list).

rules.description: Ordered rules for rule-based segments (optional, required if type is rule).

segment_type.description: Whether this is a rule-based or list-based segment.

CreateVariantRequest.description: Request to create a new flag variant.

EvaluationContext.description:
A collection of contexts used for a single evaluation.

Typical contexts include 'user', 'session', 'application', etc.

EvaluationResult.description: The result of a single flag evaluation.

EventContext.description: A single context dimension attached to an event (e.g. `user:u1`, `session:s99`).

EventDefinitionResponse.description: Response body for a single event definition.

environment_id.description: The environment this definition belongs to.

key.description: URL-safe string key, unique within the environment.

value_type.description: The metric value type this event carries.

EventPayload.description: Payload for a single event ingestion request.

contexts.description: Context dimensions for this event (e.g. user, session).

metric_key.description: Pre-registered metric key for this event.

value.description: Typed metric value; must match the registered value type.

EventValue.description:
The typed metric value carried by an event.

Exactly one variant must be present; the variant must match the registered
`EventValueType` for the event's `metric_key` or the event is rejected (422).

EventValueType.description: The metric value type an event definition accepts.

ExperimentIterationResponse.description: Response body for a single experiment iteration snapshot.

ended_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this iteration ended; `null` while running.

experiment_id.description: The experiment this iteration belongs to.

iteration_number.description: Sequential iteration number within the experiment (1-based).

metric_keys.description: Snapshot of metric keys at iteration start.

min_sample_size.description: Snapshot of minimum sample size at iteration start.

started_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this iteration started.

traffic_allocation.description: Snapshot of traffic allocation at iteration start.

ExperimentResponse.description: Response body for a single experiment.

env_id.description: The environment this experiment belongs to.

flag_rule_id.description: The flag rule this experiment is bound to.

metric_keys.description: Pre-registered event definition keys used as metrics.

min_sample_size.description: Optional informational minimum sample size guardrail.

status.description: Current lifecycle status serialized as a `snake_case` string.

ExperimentStatus.description: The lifecycle status of an experiment.

FlagHashingConfig.description: Configures which context parameters are used for hashing a specific flag.

flag_id.description: The flag this config belongs to.

order.description: The order in which parameters are combined for hashing.

FlagRecord.description:
A feature flag definition stored in the database.

Variants belonging to this flag are fetched separately via `VariantRepository`.

oneOf.description: The variant to return if no rules match.

deleted_at.description: Set when the flag is soft-deleted; `None` while active.

enabled.description: Whether evaluation is active (`true`) or the flag always returns its default.

key.description: URL-safe string key (unique within the project).

project_id.description: The project this flag belongs to.

updated_at.description: When this record was last modified.

value_type.description: The type every variant value must match.

FlagResponse.description: Full response for a single flag, including its rules and variants.

FlagRule.description: A rule associated with a feature flag.

flag_id.description: The flag this rule belongs to.

FlagValueType.description: The type of value a feature flag produces.

context_key.description: Context key to check membership for.

segment_keys.description: Segment keys to check membership against.

memberships.description: Map from segment key to membership boolean.

PercentageTarget.description: One contributor to the percentage hash input.

context_type.description: Which context type to look up.

field.description: Which field within that context to use.

Rule.description: A single rule: a condition expression paired with an output.

oneOf.description: Assign the evaluation directly to this variant.

Variant.description: Assign the evaluation directly to this variant.

oneOf.description: Hash one or more context fields to bucket into a weighted variant set.

Percentage.description: Hash one or more context fields to bucket into a weighted variant set.

targets.description: At least one target is required; values are hashed in declaration order.

weights.description: `(variant_id, weight)` pairs; weights are tenths-of-a-percent and must sum to 1000.

RuleOutput.description: The outcome produced when a rule matches.

Segment.description: A segment record stored in the database.

deleted_at.description: Set when the segment is soft-deleted; `None` while active.

environment_id.description: The environment this segment belongs to.

key.description: URL-safe string key (unique within the environment).

segment_type.description: Whether this is a rule-based or list-based segment.

updated_at.description: When this record was last modified.

allOf.description: Evaluated by matching a rule tree.

oneOf.description: Evaluated by matching a rule tree.

allOf.description: Evaluated by checking whether a context key appears in an explicit list.

oneOf.description: Evaluated by checking whether a context key appears in an explicit list.

SegmentDefinition.description: A segment definition used for evaluation.

SegmentResponse.description: Full segment details returned by the API.

segment_type.description: Whether this is a rule-based or list-based segment.

SegmentType.description: Whether a segment is rule-based or key-list-based.

TargetField.description: Identifies which field on which context to hash for percentage allocation.

TransitionRequest.description: Request body for transitioning an experiment to a new lifecycle status.

to.description: The target lifecycle status to transition to.

UpdateExperimentRequest.description: Request body for updating an existing experiment.

analysis_type.description:
Statistical analysis type (`"frequentist"` or `"bayesian"`).

**Cannot be changed while the experiment is in `running` state** — doing
so would invalidate already-computed results.  A 409 Conflict is returned
if this field is supplied for a running experiment.

metric_keys.description: Updated list of metric event definition keys (at least one required if provided).

name.description: Updated human-readable name for the experiment.

UpdateFlagRequest.description: Request to update an existing flag's metadata.

UpdateSegmentRequest.description: Request to update a segment definition.

Variant.description:
A named variant of a feature flag.

Each variant belongs to exactly one flag and carries a value whose type
must match the parent flag's [`FlagValueType`].

key.description: Human-readable key (unique within the flag, e.g. `"control"`, `"treatment"`).

value.description: The value returned when this variant is selected.

VariantValue.description:
A concrete value carried by a variant.

The discriminant must match the parent flag's [`FlagValueType`].
Use [`VariantValue::matches_type`] to enforce this invariant.
